title: Compact-support coordinate contractions without a diagonal class
statement:
Let \(A\) be a finite commutative ring and \(f:X\to Y\) proper. Use all the canonical maps and notation of [def-sf-supported-diagonal-calculus]. Let \(J\) be a lisse rank-one sheaf of \(A\)-modules on \(Y\), \(n\in\mathbb Z\), \(L=J[2n]\), and \(e:B\simeq f^*L\). For any trace-diagonal datum \(d=(t,\delta)\), define \(t_1,t_2\) from \(t\) as in that definition. For all \(M\in D_A(X)\) and \(K\in D_A(Y)\),
\[F(C_B(M));\epsilon_t(FM)=D(E_B(M));F(\pi_{p_1,M,p_2^*B}^{-1};(\mathrm{id}_M\otimes t_1);\rho_M),\]
\[C_B(H_BK);H_B(\epsilon_t(K))=P_2(c_H\otimes\mathrm{id}_{p_2^*B});\pi_{p_2,H_BK,p_2^*B}^{-1};(\mathrm{id}_{H_BK}\otimes t_2);\rho_{H_BK}.\]
Here \(\rho\) is the canonical right unitor and semicolons denote composition in application order. No condition on \(\delta\) or on either integral is assumed, and \(\delta\) does not occur in these formulas. The equalities hold on the full unbounded categories.

proof.text: For the first coordinate, apply firstExtraction to the arbitrary objects B and M. This is the Kunneth path identity before a trace is chosen. Postcompose it with d.trace tensor the identity and the left unitor. Symmetry naturality and the braided unit identity turn the final symmetry followed by trace into identity tensor d.trace followed by the right unitor.

Normalize the remaining inverse f projection followed by the scalar trace. Transport projectionTraceNormalization through rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar. Projection coincidence, naturality of the comparison, tensor naturality and right-unitor naturality prove the supported normalization. Cancel the projection isomorphism, combine the two F maps, and use the definition of traceFirst. The counit component is its specified inverse-projection, trace, left-unitor composite. This proves the first equality without using e or the line assumption.

The canonical self-symmetry of shiftedLine J n is identity. Apply secondExtraction with that equality and e. Postcompose the resulting identity with B tensor f* of (d.trace tensor identity followed by the left unitor). Naturality and left unitality of the pullback tensor comparison, symmetry naturality and the right-unitor tensor identity normalize extractionShuffle followed by this map to identity tensor (f*d.trace followed by the pullback unit comparison), then the right unitor. Functoriality combines this with the inverse coordinate and inverse exchange factors to give exactly traceSecond. The other path is the given counit inside the coefficient-first twisted pullback.

theorem contractions {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    (J : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
    (hJ : Scheme.IsLisseRankOneSheaf J) (n : ℤ) {B : DerivedCategoryModule A X}
    (e : B ≅ (CoordinateTrace.pull A f).obj (CoordinateTrace.shiftedLine A J n))
    (d : TraceDiagonalDatum A f B) :
    (∀ M : DerivedCategoryModule A X,
      (push A f).map (comparison A f B M).hom ≫ (SfDiagonalKernel.counit A d).app ((push A f).obj
        M) =
        (directComparison A f).hom.app (kernel A f B M) ≫
          (push A f).map
            ((orderedProjection A (pullback.fst f f) M
                ((CoordinateTrace.pull A (pullback.snd f f)).obj B)).inv ≫
              ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj M).map
                (SfDiagonalKernel.traceFirst A d) ≫
                (unitRightUnitor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X M).hom)) ∧
    (∀ K : DerivedCategoryModule A Y,
      (comparison A f B ((CoordinateTrace.pull A f ⋙ (derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj
        B).obj K)).hom ≫
          (CoordinateTrace.pull A f ⋙ (derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj B).map
            ((SfDiagonalKernel.counit A d).app K) =
        (push A (pullback.snd f f)).map
            (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback f f)).map
              (coordinateTwisted A f (CoordinateTrace.shiftedLine A J n) K e).hom).app
                ((CoordinateTrace.pull A (pullback.snd f f)).obj B)) ≫
          (orderedProjection A (pullback.snd f f) ((CoordinateTrace.pull A f ⋙ (derivedTensor
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj B).obj K)
              ((CoordinateTrace.pull A (pullback.snd f f)).obj B)).inv ≫
            ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj
                ((CoordinateTrace.pull A f ⋙ (derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj B).obj
                  K)).map
              (SfDiagonalKernel.traceSecond A d (CoordinateTrace.shiftedLine A J n) e) ≫
              (unitRightUnitor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X
                ((CoordinateTrace.pull A f ⋙ (derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj B).obj
                  K)).hom)
